title: Potential Equalization Between Chassis and DC-DC Converter
technician_version: Retrofitting a log-bucking harvester head onto a Terex Fuchs excavator (24 V battery, negative to chassis). New cabinet: Siemens S7-1215 PLC, KTP400 HMI, SICK absolute encoder, powered by a MEAN WELL DDR-240B-24 isolated DC-DC converter. Eaton KBSDG4V-5-92L-80-M2-PH7 proportional valve is powered directly from the excavator battery. Should the converter -Vo be bonded to cabinet/chassis or left floating? How should valve 0 V, PE and PLC 0 V be handled (separate vs single point)? Ground-loop risk through encoder/I/O/shields? Recommended potential equalization for cabinet, converter, valve and chassis, and safety/EMC risks if output is left floating.
